# SARKAR ORION

> ORION is a Fresh, Citrus, Aromatic unisex parfum from Bhuvan Bam’s SARKAR fragrance collection. "Infinite. Cold. Ambitious." 100ml, 25% perfume oil, ₹1,499 inclusive of all taxes.

This site presents ORION. Purchases take place on the official SARKAR store; the local bag does not transfer quantities to its checkout. Product notes listed on the official Orion page: top — lavender and lemon; heart — geranium, rose and cherry; base — patchouli, sandalwood and musk. Gallery images on this presentation site are illustrative campaign imagery, not official product photography.

## This site

- [ORION presentation](https://orion-ambition-page.lovable.app/): Product profile, composition, gallery and links to the official store.
